hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -n "${TANDEM_JOB_DIR:-}" ] && [ -d "$TANDEM_JOB_DIR" ]; then if [ ! -t 0 ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; ts=$(date +%s); stage=${TANDEM_STAGE:-unknown}; printf "{\"last_stop_at\":%s,\"state\":\"idle\",\"cli\":\"claude\",\"stage\":\"%s\"}\n" "$ts" "$stage" > "$TANDEM_JOB_DIR/activity.json.tmp" && mv "$TANDEM_JOB_DIR/activity.json.tmp" "$TANDEM_JOB_DIR/activity.json"; fi'
